v01-le-carmin.name: Le Carmin
v01-le-carmin.why: Michelin one star (held 2025 and 2026). To order: the market tasting menu — the kitchen does not run a fixed signature; lunch 50–59 €, dinner menus 118 / 148 / 178 €. Chef Christophe Quéant, trained with Robuchon and Ducasse. An Henri-IV house on the central square, the menu rotating strictly with the market. Closed Sun, Mon, Tue lunch.
v01-le-carmin._lane: The serious dinners — two stars inside the walls and a charcoal counter

v02-clos-du-c-dre.name: Clos du Cèdre
v02-clos-du-c-dre.why: Michelin one star (awarded 2022, held 2025 and 2026). To order: the seasonal tasting menu — terroir-anchored Burgundian, a wine list past 1,000 references. Chef Jordan Billan, inside the Hostellerie Cèdre & Spa under the great cedar that names it. Lunch Sat–Sun only; dinner Wed–Sun. Smart dress.
v02-clos-du-c-dre._lane: The serious dinners — two stars inside the walls and a charcoal counter

v04-bissoh.name: Bissoh
tags: The Japanese-Burgundian counter — sumibi-yaki on binchotan charcoal
v04-bissoh.why: The Japanese-Burgundian counter — sumibi-yaki on binchotan charcoal. To order: aged Limousin and Miyazaki beef from the charcoal grill; the omakase counter. Chef Mikihiko Sawahata cooks in front of ten seats. A very large French wine list behind a Japanese grill. Wed–Sun dinner; closed Mon–Tue.
v04-bissoh._lane: The serious dinners — two stars inside the walls and a charcoal counter

v03-ma-cuisine.name: Ma Cuisine
tags: The reference Burgundian table in Beaune, since 1996
v03-ma-cuisine.why: The reference Burgundian table in Beaune, since 1996. To order: escargots à la bourguignonne, bœuf bourguignon, roast pigeon — à la carte only, no set menu. A discreet table down a passage, beloved for its cellar — the wine list opens around 50 € and runs very deep. Reopened February 2026 under chef Mathieu Escoffier. Dinner only, closed Sunday.
v03-ma-cuisine._lane: The bouchons — the Burgundian canon, cooked straight

v07-le-bistrot-bourguignon.name: Le Bistrot Bourguignon
tags: The honest Burgundian bouchon — Menu Bourguignon 33 €
v07-le-bistrot-bourguignon.why: The honest Burgundian bouchon — Menu Bourguignon 33 €. To order: œufs en meurette, bœuf bourguignon, andouillette sauce moutarde, entrecôte sauce Époisses. Chef Mickael Thibert; a wine list past 500 references in a small room. The canon dishes done straight, no folklore. Closed Sun–Mon.
v07-le-bistrot-bourguignon._lane: The bouchons — the Burgundian canon, cooked straight

v08-la-table-du-square.name: La Table du Square
v08-la-table-du-square.why: Michelin Bib Gourmand (since 2024). To order: the market menu — rewritten every fortnight. Chef Romain Escoffier. The best value-for-craft in Beaune by Michelin's own reckoning, a wine list past 1,000 labels. Closed Sun–Mon.
v08-la-table-du-square._lane: The bouchons — the Burgundian canon, cooked straight
